title: Yeezy Season 3 Unreleased 1050 Runway Sample Boots
description: Authentic Item. YZY SZN 3 Unreleased 1050 Runway Sample Boots. One of the most notorious designs from Yeezy’s long footwear history. It was reported that Ye revisited this design over and over again for +6 months until they could finalize the design. It was then debuted at MSG for New York Fashion Week presented Season 3 along with his latest album ‘The Life of Pablo’. After the conclusion of the show, Ye would go on to wear these boots on several occasions throughout the year including during his speech about Fame at the MTV Awards. Although months would pass and eventually years with no release or update on the boot. The actual design itself is a collaboration between Yeezy, Adidas, GORTEX & Continental. Condition: Grey/Beige Preowned Sample’s from the 2016 Runway show in Madison Square Garden. Structure is in great condition. Left pair needs laces replaced. Soles are always recommended to reinforce with 1050 Samples. White/White Soles have been reinforced at cobbler, but reinforcement overtime of usage is recommended to avoid repeated damage. Minor signs of glue can still be seen around some of the soles.
